g.text: Four sampled times × 20 fixed original target lines; source-bound actions and original mobility
Development-surrogate selection audit — no dispatch-performance claim
AIDC: known-original-UID power upper bound (uncertified relaxation). STA: local-linear P/Q actions within modeled dock limits.
Scores support candidate ranking; their sum is not an achieved reduction of overall system rho.
